skill.name: photoshop-playbooks
skill.description: Use when the user asks what Manus can do with Photoshop or needs workflows for image batches, cutouts, retouching, composites, data-driven variants, reusable Actions, delivery exports, or Photoshop guidance. Routes each workflow by requested client and retained output state among Manus image tools, deterministic file processing, Photoshop Web in My Browser, and Photoshop Desktop through Computer Use.
skill.userDescription: Edit, retouch, composite, batch-produce, and export images.
exampleQuestions: Create a Photoshop workflow for batch product-photo cutouts.
Help me plan a retouching and export process.
Set up reusable Photoshop Actions for social assets.
